marks.gloss_en: תלמוד לומר מבני אהרן -- עבודה האמורה לבני אהרן (the extension to fifteen services)
טעמא דאינו מודה בה, הא מודה בה -- אף על גב דאינו בקי בהן
the reason is that he does not acknowledge it; but if he acknowledges it -- [he has a share] even though he is not expert in them
כי אמרי אנא -- באחר, שמעא -- בעל כורחיה מזכי
וכי אמרי אנא -- למאן דלא אפשר ליה, הא אפשר ליה
Rav Safra: perhaps it was read to me because I transgressed the Master's ruling?
דאמר רב יהודה אמר רב: כל השונה לתלמיד שאינו הגון נופל בגיהנם
ואין שריד אלא תלמיד חכם, שנאמר ובשרידים אשר ה' קורא

Rav: whoever teaches an unworthy student falls into Gehenna, as it says 'all darkness is laid up for his treasures; a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that remains (sarid) in his tent' (Job 20:26)
ולא היא: אי בטויא -- מידב דייבי, ואי לקדרה -- אי דמיחתך להו ומלח להו -- מידב דייבי: roasted, they drain; for the pot, cut and salted, they drain
ולפרוס ידיה! -- let him establish himself among the priests by lifting his hands [in the priestly blessing]
אנסיה ליה עידניה -- his time constrained him
ולקריוה לרבא? -- then let them read it to Rava
רבא נזוף הוה -- Rava was under rebuke
then why was it read to me? -- [it was directed] toward Rava
Rav: the veins in the jaw are forbidden
a priest who seizes the gifts -- is he showing fondness for the mitzva or contempt for it? Rava resolved: 'and he shall give' (Deut 18:3) -- not that he take by himself
Abaye: at first I would seize the gifts; I said: I am showing fondness for the mitzva
the baraita: the modest withdraw their hands, and the gluttons divide

Rav Yosef: a priest who has a young Torah scholar in his neighbourhood who is hard-pressed -- let him grant him the gifts, even though they have not come into his hand, with the acquaintances of the priesthood and Levites
Rava told the attendant: grant us the gifts, for I want to eat tongue with mustard; he granted it to him; Rava ate
Abaye to Rav Dimi: of what is the verse's plain sense written? RD: of one who teaches an unworthy student

Rav (via R' Zeira): whoever teaches an unworthy student is like one who throws a stone to Markulis, as it says 'as a stone bound in a sling (margema), so is he who gives honour to a fool' (Prov 26:8), and it is written 'luxury is not seemly for a fool' (Prov 19:10)
ואפילו עם הגוי? ורמינהו: one who partners with a gentile need not mark
the baraita: one who partners with a priest must mark
